text:
Situation: Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC neostigmine methylsulfate injection is listed on FDA's shortage list as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-01-12. The listed reason is discontinuation of the manufacture of the drug. Corvale East has 15 days on hand; Corvale General has 28 days on hand at current usage rates.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records the Fresenius Kabi product as To Be Discontinued effective 2026-01-12 due to discontinuation of manufacture. A current product label names Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as labeler and manufacturer at FEI 2220525. That plant's most recent inspection classification is NAI dated 2026-05-13; earlier inspections from 2009 through 2024 were VAI. Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Our position: Fresenius Kabi supply is ending. Hikma's current manufacturing status and inspection history suggest ongoing production capability, but supply volume to cover the gap is unconfirmed. Amneal and other listed manufacturers are not on the shortage list and represent potential alternative sources.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. to confirm available supply allocation and lead times for neostigmine methylsulfate injection; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if new NDC.
2. Buyer to contact Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC to confirm product availability, pricing, and delivery schedule; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if new NDC.
3. Buyer to evaluate Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc., BE Pharmaceuticals Inc., Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc., and Caplin Steriles Limited for supply capability; requires P&T committee approval for any new vendor.
4. Pharmacy director to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at both campuses; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: Delaying outreach to alternative manufacturers pending Fresenius Kabi depletion. Initiating clinical protocol changes without P&T committee review.
